summary: The pod and node rules and the KubeCoder exemption meet the phase. LoadBalancerNotAnnounced's `and on () metallb_speaker_announced` guard silences it when MetalLB withdraws every Service while its speakers are scraped and up, leaving only a silent warning (contradicts D3/V01; reproduced with promtool).

findings.summary: MetalLB withdrawing every Service, with speakers up, raises no critical LoadBalancerNotAnnounced; only the silent MetalLBAnnouncementsBlind warning
No test pins the `> 0` filter (the mutation survives), contrary to the done-record's claim
PodStuckInBackOff fires briefly on a loop that held ~11m, under D2's 15m; documented accepted cost
